title: Table Caption

illustrates.quote: b. Use 7-5 margins. If the table has no title or heading, insert an identifier (e.g., figure, chart, table, etc.) enclosed in transcriber's note indicators. The caption follows the identifier on the same line. (See Sample 11-1: Table Caption on page 11-25.)

print.caption: Figure 24-7  The APY is the best indicator of how much interest you will earn.
print.notes: The table itself has no title/heading of its own; "Figure 24-7" plus the sentence about APY functions as a figure caption below the table (in print).
print.printFeatures: Bordered box, shaded blue background behind the header row area; header row ("5.25%, compounded" / "APY") bold. Below the box, "Figure 24-7" is bold, followed in the same paragraph by italic caption text.
